Kit summary

Ethereal ComboBasic
Deals 2 stages of 90% ATK DMG each to a single enemy, with a 15% chance to inflict [Stun] for 1 turn.
Flash SlashActive
Deals 4 stages of 120% ATK DMG each to a single enemy, and Crit is guaranteed for the last stage of the attack. Reduces the CD of all self active skills by 1 turn whenever this skill inflicts a kill.
Divine ChallengePassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2
This effect can be triggered up to 1 time each wave. When an enemy dies, if the surviving enemies are less than 4, increases Direct DMG dealt by Malak by 30% until the wave transition. Additionally, for every 1 stage of DMG dealt by Malak, inflicts [Divine Feather] on the target. When [Divine Feather] is stacked to 16 layers, all of them will be removed and deals 200% ATK DMG to the target, with a 100% chance to inflict [Stun] for 1 turn.
Spirit Wing Blades Lv.1When [Divine Feather] is stacked to 12 layers, removes all of them and triggers Divine Challenge with 100% Piercing Rate.
Spirit Wing Blades Lv.2After Malak acts for 2 turns in total each wave, the Direct DMG bonus effect of Divine Challenge can also be triggered, during which Malak has extra 20% Crit Rate and 30% Crit DMG.
Dexterous DashActiveExclusive Lv.3
Grants self [ATK Up I] for 2 turns. Afterward, deals 4 stages of 160% ATK DMG each to a single enemy, each of which has extra 25% Piercing Rate.
Spirit Wing Blades Lv.3Dexterous Dash: Grants self [ATK Up II] for 2 turns instead. Increases the extra Piercing Rate of each stage's attack to 40%.
